PLAINTIFF, JAMES BLANDING, IS AWARDED RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION 0F 4642 THIRD STREET, SAN FRANCISCO. A MONEY JUDGMENT OF $792.50 IS ALSO AWARDED PLAINTIFF, JAMES BLANDING. THIS IS FOR RENT AND DAMAGES FOR DECEMBER, 1994 AND JANUARY, 1995. PLAINTIFF, JAMES BLANDING SHALL OBTAIN A WRIT OF POSSESSION IMMEDIATELY BUT NO ACTUAL EVICTION SHALL TAKE PLACE UNTIL 1-16-95. DEFENDANTS, HAROLD AND BRENDA CASTLE SHALL PAY THE MONEY JUDGMENT AS FOLLOWS: 1-6-95 $495 1-16-95 $297.50 A SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT SHALL BE FILED WITH THE COURT IF THE ABOVE CONDITIONS ARE MET. THE ABOVE CONDITIONS INCLUDE DEFENDANTS, HAROLD AND BRENDA CASTLE MOVING OUT OF 4642 THIRD STREET ON OR BEFORE 1-16-95. PLAINTIFF, JAMES BLANDING SHALL PREPARE THE NECESSARY PAPERS OUTLINING THE SETTLEMENT.
TRIAL OFF CALENDAR

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CASTLE, BRENDA GARCIA CASTLE, HAROLD ALEXANDER THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 4642 THIRD STREET, SAN FRANCISCO CA 94124 $792.50 RENT, TOTAL JUDGMENT $792.50, LEASE FORFEITED
